entry.title: InCad 0.11.3: Hide Edges works after the Shaded button
entry.content:
Fixed

  • Appearance ▸ Hide Edges did nothing once the Shaded button had been used: Shaded drew the edges of every Solid whatever its setting. Now each Solid is shown as it is set, so Hide Edges hides its edges.
